title: Artificial intelligence for opportunistic osteoporosis screening on chest radiographs
abstract: We developed an artificial intelligence model (AI-OsRM) to predict osteoporosis and reduced bone mineral density (BMD) from chest radiographs (CXR) and evaluated its performance and clinical utility across three external cohorts. AI-OsRM was developed using 46,478 paired CXR and dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) examinations from 26,757 patients collected at a tertiary referral hospital between 2016 and 2022, using a ResNet-based architecture with masked autoencoder pretraining. External validation was performed in three independent cohorts, including a temporally separated hospital cohort (SNUH; n = 6391) and two large health checkup cohorts (HPC, n = 24,132; YSMC, n = 122,535). In the SNUH cohort, AI-OsRM achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.88 (95% CI: 0.87–0.89) for both osteoporosis and reduced BMD. In the health checkup cohorts, AUROCs for osteoporosis detection were 0.93 (95% CI: 0.92–0.93) in HPC and 0.92 (95% CI: 0.92–0.92) in YSMC. Simulation analyses demonstrated that AI-OsRM–based prescreening could reduce DXA utilization by approximately 50% while maintaining detection of 98-99% of osteoporosis cases and 80–90% of reduced BMD cases. These findings suggest that AI-OsRM can enable accurate identification of individuals with osteoporosis or reduced BMD and may serve as an effective prescreening tool to optimize DXA utilization.
takeaway: 흉부 X선만으로 골다공증을 예측하는 AI가 세 개의 외부 코호트에서 AUROC 0.88~0.93을 보였고, DXA 검사를 약 50% 줄이면서 골다공증의 98~99%를 찾아낼 수 있다고 주장한다.
relevance: 우리 코호트는 흉부 X선 272건(환자 153명, 5개 기관)으로, PA 184건과 AP 88건이 섞여 있고 나이는 9~87세, 남녀 각 136건입니다. 기관과 촬영 자세가 다양해 외부 검증 관점에서 비교해 볼 수 있는 구성이지만, 이 논문과 같은 규모는 아닙니다.
caveat: 우리 데이터에는 DXA 등 골밀도 기준 표준이 없어 골다공증 예측 성능을 확인할 수 없습니다. 또한 전 건이 합성 영상이라 실제 촬영 조건의 일반화를 보증하지 못합니다.
check: AP 촬영과 고령 환자처럼 이 논문의 학습 분포에서 드문 하위군에서도 AUROC가 유지되는지 보고되어 있는가?
